secretsUnrevealed: brock-usa: His 'seven-figure startup' is a lemonade-stand LLC with $43 in the bank and one investor: his mom.
poppy-uk: Keeps a notebook of catastrophically sincere romantic poetry under her mattress. Two of the poems rhyme 'Lucas' with 'ruckus'.
matteo-italy: He is lactose intolerant. The mozzarella devotion is a beautiful, agonizing lie he suffers for nightly.
elodie-france: Owns every cheesy American rom-com ever made and sobs at all of them, including the trailers.
lucas-brazil: He cannot swim. Beach volleyball champion, yes. Deep end: an unspoken horror he has been faking around for six days.
sienna-australia: Was engaged once, for 48 hours, to a man she met at a jet-ski rental. She still has the ring on a keyring.
rohan-india: His famous 'compatibility algorithm' is astrology in a spreadsheet wearing a lanyard.
greta-germany: Cries at dog videos every night at 22:15, precisely, in the bathroom, with the fan on.
alejandro-spain: He applied to the show four times. The smolder took eleven months of mirror practice and one pulled facial muscle.
previousEpisodeSummary: Season premiere — nothing has happened yet. Everything is about to.
